Propose boundaries for difficult bright or dark colonies

Source: R/guided-recovery.R
suggest_funmel_polygons.Rd

Click-guided, local lightness segmentation for the four peripheral targets. This creates a proposal for visual review, not measurements or an automatic exception to quality control. Use manual overrides when an edge is ambiguous.

Usage

suggest_funmel_polygons(
  path,
  dish_diameter_mm,
  centre = c("fungus", "none"),
  dish = NULL,
  seeds = NULL,
  radius_px = NULL,
  polarity = "auto",
  min_contrast = 3,
  fraction = 0.35,
  polygons = list(),
  exclusions = list(),
  max_dim = 1200,
  boundary = c("outer_extent", "seed_component"),
  central_auto = TRUE,
  central_seed = NULL,
  central_radius_px = NULL,
  central_fraction = 0.1
)

# S3 method for class 'funmel_boundary_proposal'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

path

Original photograph.

dish_diameter_mm

Verified outer dish diameter in millimetres.

centre

Central partner model, fungus or none.

dish

Outer rim circle c(x,y,r) in working pixels; NULL requests three clicks.

seeds

Four-row x/y matrix with row names TL, TR, BR, BL. NULL requests one click per target. Seeds are in the resized working image, not original pixels.

radius_px

Search radius, one number or a named vector for all four targets. The outer 20 percent estimates local agar lightness. Default is 0.25 times the dish radius. Keep other colonies, rim and writing outside this region.

polarity

One of auto, bright, dark, or a named vector for all targets.

min_contrast

Minimum lightness difference from local agar, default 3.

fraction

Fraction of seed contrast used as the threshold, between 0 and 1.

polygons

Optional named manual overrides. A central_fungus outline is required for confrontations; if absent it is proposed by central_auto or optionally collected interactively when central_auto=FALSE.

exclusions

List of x/y polygons marking artifacts. They are excluded from seed/background estimation and detection. This does not reconstruct hidden tissue or modify the photograph.

max_dim

Maximum working-image dimension.

boundary

outer_extent (default) proposes the outermost closed candidate enclosing the target seed, including its interior. seed_component uses only the connected candidate containing the seed. Both require visual review; use a manual outline for open rims, mixed organisms or uncertain boundaries.

central_auto

Propose central fungal extent automatically (default). FALSE retains the optional interactive manual central outline.

central_seed

Optional central x/y seed; default is the dish centre.

central_radius_px

Central search radius; default 0.75 times dish radius.

central_fraction

Central seed-contrast fraction, default 0.1. This is a lightness threshold proposal, not a validated biological hyphal edge.

x

Boundary proposal to display.

...

Reserved for plotting extensions.

Value

A funmel_boundary_proposal containing polygons, image geometry and per-target detection diagnostics. Failed targets have no polygon and must be supplied manually. plot() displays outlines for review. No measurements are calculated. Use recover_funmel_plate() with the reviewed polygons.

Details

Local brightness is used only to propose geometry. The original photograph is retained for measurement; existing explicit calibration settings still apply when running recovery. Automatic mode chooses bright/dark from the seed and surrounding agar; it does not establish biological identity. Central fungal extent is proposed independently from local lightness contrast; inspect the visible fringe because a plug-based seed can miss differently coloured peripheral tissue. Supplied manual boundaries take precedence. Mask contact with the search limit is rejected. A radius is a search window, never a forced circular boundary.
